# Orbitalis agents

Read AGENTS.md and docs/contributors before repository changes. Follow the same ownership, checkout,
verification and licensing rules across assistants. Only project-specific skills live in .agents/skills.
Shared ai-skills are optional user tooling; setup is documented in docs/contributors/development.md.
AGENTS.md and contributor guides are sufficient when shared skills are absent.

This repository does not yet have a configured GitHub remote or Roadmap project. Do not reuse Compukters'
issue numbers, project IDs, status IDs or credentials. Once the owner requests roadmap setup, configure
this repository's own fenced yaml roadmap block here and apply using-github-roadmap to architectural work.
Use gh for authorized GitHub operations. Do not create external issues, releases or PRs as a side effect
of the bootstrap. Preserve user instructions and existing authorization.
